Name: Pink Alex
Author: OftenUno
Description:
I experiment with mods for the first time by giving Alex pink hair!

Winter clothing included.

Should download like any other mod: download, unzip, move to mods folder! if that [i]doesn't[/i] work please let me know!!!

I will hopefully put out more and far better portrait or recolour mods as I get better (and as long as it doesn't take me five hours again T_T)
